You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0144.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol()
# atoms heavy 0-17 C and 18-19 O
for i in range(18): rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C'))
for i in range(2): rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('O'))
bonds=[(0,1,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(1,2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(1,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(2,3,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(2,4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(3,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(3,12,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(4,5,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(5,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(4,7,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(8,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,10,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,11,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(12,13,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(12,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(13,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(12,15,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,16,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(16,17,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
(15,18,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(17,19,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]
for a,b,t in bonds: rw.AddBond(a,b,t)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
coords={0:(220,20),1:(238,138),2:(238,267),3:(238,345),4:(168,291),5:(47,253),6:(128,383),7:(112,215),8:(278,249),9:(321,208),10:(379,308),11:(390,355),12:(339,400),13:(398,385),14:(426,490),15:(305,520),16:(192,551),17:(174,627),18:(366,574),19:(136,667)}
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y) in coords.items(): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x,-y,0.0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
conf=m.GetConformer()
# set wedged H at B toward viewer
hB=next(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(8).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H')
conf.SetAtomPosition(hB,Point3D(230,-270,30))
# set OH bond toward viewer at L, H opposite plane
conf.SetAtomPosition(18,Point3D(366,-574,35))
hL=next(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(15).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H')
conf.SetAtomPosition(hL,Point3D(330,-580,-30))
# set tags based on 3D structure
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('tagged centers')
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
  print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
# remove accidental stereo except B/L. Keep tags derived for idx 8 and 15 only
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetIdx() not in (8,15): a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('selected stereo')
for i in [8,15]:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i);print(i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
# Need embedding should use stereo tags
m.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=12044; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',ret)
if ret<0:
 raise SystemExit('embed failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
print('MMFF props',props is not None)
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,mmffVariant='MMFF94s',maxIters=1000)
print('opt',res)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for i in [8,15]:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i);print('final stereo',i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
# output XYZ all atoms
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
 f.write('Structure generated from mol_0144.png\n')
 for atom in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))

oet=atom('O',-1); e1=atom('C'); e2=atom('C')

N=atom('N'); NH=atom('N'); ac=atom('C'); oac=atom('O'); ch2=atom('C')
# phenyl positions
ar=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]; oph=atom('O')
# Cu coordination
rw.AddBond(cl,cu,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
rw.AddBond(oet,e1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE); rw.AddBond(e1,e2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(oet,cu,Chem.BondType.DATIVE) # O -> Cu
rw.AddBond(ooxo,A,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); rw.AddBond(ooxo,cu,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)

rw.AddBond(A,B,Chem.BondType.SINGLE); rw.AddBond(B,C,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); rw.AddBond(C,D,Chem.BondType.SINGLE); rw.AddBond(D,E,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); rw.AddBond(E,F,Chem.BondType.SINGLE); rw.AddBond(F,A,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(F,G,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); rw.AddBond(G,N,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(N,NH,Chem.BondType.SINGLE); rw.AddBond(NH,ac,Chem.BondType.SINGLE); rw.AddBond(ac,oac,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); rw.AddBond(ac,ch2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(ch2,ar[0],Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
for i in range(6): rw.AddBond(ar[i],ar[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)

rw.AddBond(ar[3],oph,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(N,cu,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)

# explicit Hs based on valence incl special coordination

cat > build_mol0144.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

rw=Chem.RWMol()
for _ in range(18): rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('C'))
for _ in range(2): rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('O'))
S=Chem.BondType.SINGLE; D=Chem.BondType.DOUBLE
edges=[(0,1,D),(1,2,S),(1,8,S),(2,3,S),(2,4,S),(2,8,S),
       (3,6,S),(3,12,S),(4,5,S),(5,6,S),(4,7,S),
       (8,9,S),(8,10,S),(10,11,S),(12,13,S),(12,14,S),(13,14,S),
       (12,15,S),(15,16,S),(16,17,S),(15,18,S),(17,19,S)]
for i,j,b in edges: rw.AddBond(i,j,b)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# 2-D depiction coordinates in image-plane coordinates, used to set the indicated wedges.
xy={0:(220,20),1:(238,138),2:(238,267),3:(238,345),4:(168,291),5:(47,253),6:(128,383),7:(112,215),8:(278,249),9:(321,208),10:(379,308),11:(390,355),12:(339,400),13:(398,385),14:(426,490),15:(305,520),16:(192,551),17:(174,627),18:(366,574),19:(136,667)}
c=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y) in xy.items(): c.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x,-y,0.0))
m.AddConformer(c)
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
c=m.GetConformer()
# Solid wedge B-C2 points toward the viewer (positive z); OH at L is also solid wedge.
p=c.GetAtomPosition(2); c.SetAtomPosition(2,Point3D(p.x,p.y,30.0))
c.SetAtomPosition(18,Point3D(366,-574,35.0))
hL=next(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(15).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H')
c.SetAtomPosition(hL,Point3D(330,-580,-30.0))
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
# Only the stereocenters indicated by explicit wedge bonds are specified in the drawing.
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetIdx() not in (8,15): a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('stereochemistry:')
for i in (8,15):
    a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
    print(i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=144; p.useSmallRingTorsions=True
if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)<0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,mmffVariant='MMFF94s',maxIters=1000)
print('MMFF optimization status:',res)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for i in (8,15):
    a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i); print('final',i,a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
c=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
    f.write('3D structure generated from mol_0144.png\n')
    for a in m.GetAtoms():
        p=c.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('heavy formula C18O2; atom count:',m.GetNumAtoms())
print('SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
